answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the echo log reveals the live set and the lantern audit records each lapse. Keeping 39 aliases alive therefore means 39 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the reef quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 108 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
